name: Desperate Times

faq.answer: Valennia Stormfist is in Valanaar, where she has been planning an assault on the cult's shrine. The attack depends on cooperation between rival factions.
Lorthuna is a key figure in the hostile cult. She is directing a critical scheme at the shrine, making her the target of the planned strike.
The cult cannot be safely confronted in the open. The plan is to strike at the shrine and stop Lorthuna before her scheme comes to fruition.
faq.q: Why must the shrine be attacked directly?

faq.answer: Tensions run high between the Windshapers and the High Order. Neither faction can carry out the assault on the shrine alone, so both must cooperate.
faq.q: What is the issue between the Windshapers and the High Order?

faq.answer: Valanaar is where Valennia Stormfist is coordinating the plan and rallying allies for a strike against the cult's shrine.

aliases: what is the plan desperate times
faq.answer: The goal is to find Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, learn the details of her planned strike, and help secure cooperation between the divided factions.
faq.q: What is the overall goal of this mission?

sections.body: The cult cannot be safely faced in the open, so the defenders need a bolder plan. They will strike at the cult's shrine instead of fighting a long battle on unfavorable ground. If they eliminate Lorthuna before she completes her part in the cult's grand scheme, they can cripple the threat at its source.
sections.title: A Direct Strike

sections.body: In Valanaar, Valennia Stormfist has spent time planning an assault on the shrine. The attack needs substantial reinforcements and strength united across the factions. Yet the Windshapers and the High Order remain divided by severe political tensions, putting their alliance at risk.
sections.title: Uniting Divided Factions

summary: Valennia Stormfist waits in Valanaar with a plan to strike the cult at its shrine. Lorthuna must be stopped there, but the Windshapers and the High Order must first set aside their deep tensions.
